# Atlas Data and Registration
The Course Atlas gathers offerings from Emory programs; data is refreshed from OPUS and class changes are reflected. Registration indicators identify class status and additional steps.
# Search Fields
Atlas filters include subject, campus, GER, session, instruction method, component type, open or waitlisted status, meeting time, and attributes. A course search can be pushed from the primary cart to OPUS.
# Keyword Search
Atlas keyword search checks code, title, description, then other fields. The registrar says to search the subject abbreviation (for example, PHIL) to retrieve all courses in that subject; searching the word Philosophy is not equivalent.
# Syllabi and Carts
An instructor may provide a syllabus, which can require Office 365 login. A saved secondary cart must be moved to the primary cart before pushing it to OPUS.
